description: This file defines an abstract class 'EntityOperator' and related comparison and join operators used for constructing and managing entity query conditions in the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityOperator
classes.description: Abstract base class for entity comparison and join operators used in building query conditions.

classes.name: EntityComparisonOperator
classes.description: Subclass of EntityOperator for comparison operations on comparable entities.

classes.name: EntityJoinOperator
classes.description: Subclass of EntityOperator for join operations (AND, OR) in query conditions.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code representing the operator.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the integer ID of the operator.

methods.name: entityMatches
methods.description: Checks if the entity matches the condition based on the operator.

methods.name: appendRHSList
methods.description: Appends a list of RHS values to the SQL where clause.

methods.name: appendRHSBetweenList
methods.description: Appends a list of values for BETWEEN clause to the SQL where clause.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the condition is empty.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a map matches the condition.

methods.name: validateSql
methods.description: Abstract method to validate SQL syntax for the condition.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Abstract method to add the operator's value to SQL statement.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Creates an immutable representation of the condition.
